newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes unchanged against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes unchanged against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan ended at 8.3055 against the U.S. dollar on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market on Tuesday, unchanged from Monday's close, traders said.
The yuan opened down slightly at an intra-day low of 8.3056 and moved between 8.3056 and 8.3053 for most of the session, hitting a high of 8.3050.
Trading was dull with most done at about 8.3054, traders said.
Dealers said the yuan was capped at the 8.3050-level by heavy selling mostly from the central bank.
"It is certain that the People's Bank of China limited the yuan's uptrend at 8.3050 today," one dealer said.
"But it is doubtful that such an intervention will continue in the short term," he added.
Dealers expect the yuan to close above 8.3050 on Wednesday.
The yuan closed up at 7.5850 from 7.5980 against 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0735 from 1.0755 against the Hong Kong dollar.
